shared_elements: horizontal register bands dividing the composition
repeated row of similar motifs along a band
figures shown in profile facing one direction
elongated linear/rod-like objects held or laid horizontally
justification: Both are stone reliefs organised into stacked horizontal registers with profile creatures and repeated motifs running along a band, which gives a loose structural echo. However, A is a schematic, shallow, almost pictographic carving of abstracted animals on a free-standing pillar, while B is a polished, detailed relief of bearded human figures with rendered garments, hair and a floral rosette border — the level of naturalism and technical finish is entirely different.
